evidence.quote: Troxy first opened its doors in 1933
Our building has step-free access via the front entrance, and throughout the upper section of the ground floor.
there’s no lift to the Circle seating upstairs, and this can only be accessed via 43 steps to our upper level.
Our accessible toilet is located in the left-hand side of the foyer through the main entrance, and is accessible via Radar key.
Everyone’s welcome at Troxy – our team will always do their best to accommodate you and make sure your visit is relaxed, welcoming and accessible.

findings.value: Step-free to the front entrance and the upper ground floor. The Circle has no lift and is reached by 43 steps; Front Stalls are reached by 3 steps down, so they are not step-free. One free carer ticket comes with each accessible ticket. The accessibility team can be emailed for help; for weekend events, ask by 6pm on the Friday before. A Hot Pink Wristband is available for non-visible conditions. The only hearing loop mentioned is at the box office window.

evidence.quote: Please note that Front Stalls tickets are not step-free accessible, as the lower ground floor area at the front of the auditorium is only accessible via 3 steps down from the upper ground floor.
The accessible ticket policy limits one free carer ticket to each accessible ticket purchased.
You can contact our accessibility team directly at accesstickets@troxy.co.uk
Hot Pink Wristbands are a discreet and simple way to indicate non-visible disabilities/conditions
We have a hearing loop system in place at our box office window.

findings.value: Tickets are sold online only; the venue does not sell tickets by phone.

evidence.quote: Unfortunately, we don’t sell tickets over the phone, as we’re a digital only venue.

findings.value: Varies by event; shown on each event listing and on ticketing sites.

evidence.quote: Age restrictions will vary for each event and will be listed on our website and on ticketing sites when you purchase tickets
as the capacity increases from 3,100 to 3,600

notes: The accessibility page was last changed on 1 October 2026 according to its own page data, so it is current. Step-free is true for the main entrance and upper ground floor, not the whole building: the Circle and the Front Stalls are not step-free. The hearing loop is at the box office window only, so no whole-venue hearing loop is claimed. Capacity 3,600 is from the venue's history page, which describes the 2026 refurbishment; the venue's specs page was not read.
